guest.title: New on the platform 🚀
guest.text: Now clients can post jobs and taskers can apply directly. Join to start working or hiring instantly.

tasker.title: New for Taskers 💼

client.title: New for Clients 🧑‍💼
client.text: Post jobs, review applications, and manage taskers in one place. Hire faster and easier.
